aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable process-test evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are too mixed for final use.
issues: Changed factor merges temperature, time, height, dry-oven setting, and use flags into one unclear comparison.
Baseline/test conditions vary by date and are not consistently preserved as row-level groups.
Some domains are misclassified as material/coating/dimension despite process-condition evidence.
O: use and measurement aggregates appear misparsed or unsupported as outcomes.
Several outcomes cite only headers or uncited data rows, weakening traceability.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factors as process-condition changes by sheet/date/test round.
Keep heating temperature, press time, height setting, dry-oven setting/actual, and use flag as subgroup keys.
Separate defect outcomes from header-derived measurement summaries and drop unsupported O: use metrics.
Cite each compared data row, not only section titles or headers.
Rejudge each comparison within the same sheet/date context before approval.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Source-row IDs exist, but citations are not sufficient for all claims because key outcomes rely on headers or ambiguous rows.
